description: This is a Perl script used for flashing firmware on a D-Link DSL-502T device. It includes functions for device discovery over UDP, firmware validation, environment interaction via FTP, and flashing procedures, including checks and optional reconfiguration of memory segments.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP with custom methods for interacting with the ADAM2 bootloader, including environment variable retrieval, rebooting, and command execution.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Sends a USER command to the FTP server and returns the response.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an environment variable from the FTP server.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method to get environment variable values.

methods.name: _REBOOT
methods.description: Sends REBOOT command to FTP server to restart the device.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Public method to reboot the device via FTP.
